question: For the TCGA cancer cohorts in the HPA cancer prognostics, give a grouped bar chart of the number of validated favourable versus validated unfavourable prognostic genes per cancer, a dot plot of the ten cancers with the most prognostic genes in total, and the table behind both.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Cancer, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT Gene) AS genes, MIN(\"validated prognostic - favorable\") AS min_fav, MAX(\"validated prognostic - favorable\") AS max_fav, MIN(\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\") AS min_unfav, MAX(\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\") AS max_unfav FROM cancer_prognostic_data GROUP BY Cancer ORDER BY Cancer;"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Cancer, Abbriviation, \"Cancer group\", Organ, \"Num samples\" FROM cancer_rna_tcga_cancers ORDER BY Cancer;"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH counts AS (SELECT Cancer, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE \"validated prognostic - favorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - favorable\" <> '') AS validated_favorable, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '') AS validated_unfavorable FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer LIKE '%(TCGA)' GROUP BY Cancer) SELECT Cancer, validated_favorable, validated_unfavorable, validated_favorable + validated_unfavorable AS total_prognostic_genes FROM counts ORDER BY total_prognostic_genes DESC, Cancer;"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Cancer, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE \"validated prognostic - favorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - favorable\" <> '' AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '') AS both_validated, COUNT(DISTINCT Gene) FILTER (WHERE (\"validated prognostic - favorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - favorable\" <> '') OR (\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '')) AS distinct_total FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer LIKE '%(TCGA)' GROUP BY Cancer HAVING both_validated > 0 ORDER BY Cancer;"}
